blocks.alt: Each Recursive Call Returns a Different Value

blocks.content: When the base condition is reached, the final function returns "Done".
As this value propagates back through the chain of recursive calls, the string " over" is repeatedly concatenated to the previous return value.
This results in the function returning "Done", then "Done over", then "Done over over", and finally "Done over over over", which is shown by the table below:
